title: Engine and Motor Performance
summary: Feedback on the G60 engine or motor combines strong praise for overall powertrain appeal with a few concrete complaints about stumbling at idle and failure to start, while many sampled mentions are too generic or descriptive to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the engine or motor as a favorite part of the vehicle and describe it as very good or very nice.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report specific engine issues including brief idle stumbles and complete no-start events that led to loss of electrical function and towing.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention engine size, configuration, or improvement prompts without enough detail to confirm a clear opinion.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are generic prompts or brief statements, so the specific engine attributes behind the sentiment are often unclear.
The example set is dominated by repeated wording about loving the engine or motor, which limits detail on what concrete qualities were appreciated.
Undetermined fragments include both descriptive specifications and vague improvement statements, reducing clarity about the underlying experience.
